title: Hohenschönhausen - Quick Summary
items: **The prison is tour-only.** You cannot walk the cells, corridors or interrogation rooms on your own. The site is open daily 10:00 to 18:00 and the exhibitions in the front building are free, but the prison itself opens only with a guide.
**English tours run daily at 10:40, 12:40 and 14:40.** Tickets are 9 euro standard, 5 euro concession and 2.50 euro for school pupils. Allow about 2 hours including the short introductory film.
**Book ahead.** Each tour is capped at 25 people and the memorial recommends booking through its ticket shop. Groups of seven or more must book.
**The guides are former prisoners of this building and historians.** The memorial gives an age recommendation of 14 and over. Photography for private use is allowed on the tour.

**The M5 tram is the best way there.** It runs direct from Hackescher Markt and Alexanderplatz, about 33 minutes door to door from Alexanderplatz with no changes. The whole trip is inside fare zone AB.

**Get off at Freienwalder Str., not Genslerstr.** Freienwalder Str. is about 570 metres from the gate. The Genslerstr. tram stop shares the street name but sits about 850 metres away, and bus 256 to Große-Leege-Str./Freienwalder Str. is closest at about 280 metres.
**Ignore the S-Bahn station called Hohenschönhausen.** It is about 2.8 kilometres from Genslerstraße 66, and the memorial's own directions tell visitors not to use it.
**Budget half a day.** The 10:40 tour from Alexanderplatz means leaving around 09:52 and being back in the centre around 13:13. Pair it with a light afternoon.
